howto.game_objective_desc:
Game Objective

Baccarat is played on a large gaming table with 8 decks of 52 cards. The objective of the game is to guess who between the banker and the player will get the closest score to 9.
howto.mb_game_objective_desc:
Game Objective

Baccarat is played on a large gaming table with 8 decks of 52 cards. The objective of the game is to guess who between the banker and the player will get the closest score to 9.
howto.game_play_list:
Types of Baccarat

  1. CLASSIC - It is Baccarat that is commonly played.
  2. FLIPPY™ TABLE - A variation of the classic Baccarat game wherein the user can squeeze or take a peek at the cards for a limited time.
  3. SUPER 6 - Super 6 is a Non-Commission Baccarat which offers a side bet on a Super 6 slot. Every time Banker wins with a score of six (6), bets on Super 6 wins 12:1 and Banker pays 0.50:1.
  4. MULTIPLAYER - A seven (7) seater table with live bets available for Classic and Super 6 Baccarat.
howto.mb_game_play_list:
Types of Baccarat

  1. CLASSIC - It is Baccarat that is commonly played.
  2. FLIPPY™ TABLE - A variation of the classic Baccarat game wherein the user can squeeze or take a peek at the cards for a limited time.
  3. SUPER 6 - Super 6 is a Non-Commission Baccarat which offers a side bet on a Super 6 slot. Every time Banker wins with a score of six (6), bets on Super 6 wins 12:1 and Banker pays 0.50:1.
  4. MULTIPLAYER - A seven (7) seater table with live bets available for Classic and Super 6 Baccarat.
howto.game_play_list_2:
Gameplay

  • To begin, players are given 20 seconds to bet either on the "player", "banker", “tie”, “player pair” or “banker pair”.
  • After all bets are down, the croupier gives two cards each alternately to the player and the banker markers.
  • A total of 8 or 9 is called a “natural”. The hands are revealed and the one with the highest score wins the round.
  • You can’t have more than 9 points when playing Baccarat. If total card value is over 10, the second digit is the total score (for example 15 becomes 5).

howto.flippy_baccarat_desc_pc:
During a Flippy™ Baccarat game, players can slowly peek at their cards to add excitement during gameplay. Cards dealt will be shown at the center of the screen. Click and hold each card to squeeze or click to open all cards at once.

The time allotted to peek at the first two dealt cards is 13 seconds. If a Hit Card is dealt, time allotted to peek is 8 seconds.
howto.mb_flippy_baccarat_desc:
During a Flippy™ Baccarat game, players can slowly peek at their cards to add excitement during gameplay. Cards dealt will show on the screen. You can tap-and-hold and drag each card to squeeze or press to open all cards at once.

The time allotted to peek at the first two dealt cards is 13 seconds. If a Hit Card is dealt, time allotted to peek is 8 seconds.
howto.betting_buttons_desc_pc:
The center area of the screen displays the Undo, Confirm and Clear Buttons when placing your bets. The total time allotted for placing bets is 20 seconds. On the last 10 seconds, the timer turns orange.

The Undo Button changes to a Repeat Button if you want to repeat a previous bet.

lobby.title: Poker
lobby.content1: Nihtan Poker is a heads up form of Texas Hold’em Poker that is played online between a Dealer and Player/s.
lobby.content1-5: The goal is simple: win as many chips as you can, one pot at a time. You win a pot by having the best hand against the dealer.
lobby.numbered_content:
1. Royal Flush：10, J, Q, K, A all of the same suit

2. Straight Flush：Any 5 suited cards in sequence

a.) Highest Straight Flush - (K, Q, J, 10, 9) All of the same suit


b.) Lowest Straight Flush - (6, 5, 4, 3, 2) All of the same suit


Note: A-2-3-4-5 of the same suit is not considered a Straight Flush but an Ace High Flush.

3. Four of a Kind：All 4 cards of the same rank

4. Full House:Three cards of the same rank combined with a pair

5. Flush ：Any 5 suited cards but not in sequence

6. Straight ：Any 5 off suit cards in sequence

a.) Highest Straight - (A, K, Q, J, 10) Off suit


b.) Lowest Straight - (6, 5, 4, 3, 2) Off suit


Note: A-2-3-4-5 of the same suit is not considered a Straight but a High Card.

7. Three of a Kind ：Three cards of the same rank

8. Two Pairs ：Two separate pairs

9. Pair ：Two cards of the same rank

10. High Card ：Unrelated cards ranked by the highest single card
lobby.ante_desc: A player should bet in the ante wager to be given hole cards.
lobby.bonus_desc: A player can only place a wager if he/she has placed an ante bet and can win a corresponding bonus.
lobby.flop_desc: Player’s option to RAISE or FOLD
lobby.turn_desc: Player’s option to CALL or CHECK
lobby.river_desc: Player’s option to CALL or CHECK
lobby.bullet-content:
•Dealer pays 1:1 on Ante Bet if poker hand is Straight or better, if not, bet is forfeited.
•If you fold during the first round, you lose your Ante Bet and Bonus Bet.
lobby.content8:
In case of same hand ranking, highest card in rank from either the player or dealer’s hole cards wins the game.
To break a tie, the hole cards of the player and dealer will determine the winner. There are three possible situations:
lobby.title9: 1.  ONE (1) hole card forms the winning hand
lobby.title10: 1.  ONE (1) hole card forms the winning hand
lobby.content10: 1.1. Highest kicker card in rank from the hole cards wins the game.
lobby.content10-1: 1.2. In case the kicker cards are same in rank, highest in suit ranking of the second next in rank wins the game.
lobby.title11: 2. TWO (2) hole cards form the winning hand
lobby.content11: 2.1. If both cards have the same rank, the suit rank of the second higher card will determine the winner.
lobby.content11-1: 2.2. In case the hole cards are an identical pair in rank, the highest suit in rank wins the game.
lobby.title12: 3.  NONE of the hole cards forms the winning hand
lobby.content12: 3.1. Highest card in rank from the hole cards the game.
lobby.content12-1: 3.2. In case the highest card is the same in rank from the hole cards, next highest card in rank shall prevail.
lobby.content12-2: 3.3. If the next highest card is still the same in rank, the suit rank of the latter will determine the winner.

tutorials.playerInfo_desc:
This shows your avatar, user ID, and your games’ winning percentage.
You can change your avatar at the lobby settings.
tutorials.betInfo_desc: This displays your available credit balance for the current game, total bet amount placed, and total amount won during the current round.
tutorials.channelBetlimit_desc:
This displays the current channel
you are in and the game’s bet limit.
tutorials.gameMenu_desc: The side Menu shows various game options such as changing the game settings, modifying the chips to use, viewing bet and transfer logs, and viewing the game rules.
tutorials.chipRack_desc: The chip tray area displays the chips of your betting denomination. You may click the “Modify Chips” menu to customize the chips.
tutorials.betButton_desc: The Undo, Confirm, and Clear buttons are used to modify, finalize, and cancel your bets. The Repeat button is displayed when there is a previous bet that you want to repeat for the current round.
tutorials.timer_desc: You have 20 seconds betting time, and in the last 10 seconds the timer turns orange.
tutorials.bettingLayout_desc: This is where you place your bets. Single player, multiplayer, and other games will have different betting layout.
tutorials.bettingLayoutMulti_desc: In Baccarat multiplayer, your betting area is the fifth(5th) seat.
tutorials.flippyCard_desc: Cards dealt will show at the center of the screen. You can click and hold each card to squeeze or click to open all cards at once.
tutorials.cardDisplay_desc: This displays the card values being dealt and scanned. In Flippy Baccarat, the display includes a squeeze feature to slowly peek the cards.
tutorials.mb_intro_desc: Before you play this game, you are recommended to start the beginner’s guide. This will give you a walkthrough of the game’s interface.
tutorials.mb_delearInfoChannel_desc: This shows the dealer’s name, the game number, and the winning percentage of Player, Banker, and Tie. It also displays the current channel you are in and the game’s bet limit.
tutorials.mb_betInfo_desc: This displays your available credit balance for the current game, the total bet amount placed, and the total amount won during the current round.
tutorials.mb_gameStatistics_desc: This displays the scoreboard, game predictions, number of deals per shoe, and the winning occurrences of Player, Banker, and Tie.
tutorials.mb_playerInfo_desc: This shows your avatar, user ID, and your games’ winning percentage. You can change your avatar at the lobby settings.
tutorials.mb_gameMenu_desc: The toggle Menu shows and hides various game options such as changing the game settings, modifying the chips to use, viewing bet and transfer logs, and viewing the game rules.
tutorials.mb_chipRack_desc: The chip tray area displays the chips of your betting denomination. You may click the “Modify Chips” menu to customize the chips.
tutorials.mb_betButton_desc: The Undo, Confirm, and Clear buttons are used to modify, finalize, and cancel your bets, The Repeat button is displayed when there is a previous bet that you want to repeat for the current round.
tutorials.mb_timer_desc: You have 20 seconds betting time, and in the last 10 seconds the timer turns orange.
tutorials.mb_bettingLayout_desc: This is where you place your bets.  Single player, multiplayer, and other games will have different betting layout.
tutorials.mb_bettingLayoutMulti_desc: In Baccarat multiplayer, your betting area is the fifth(5th) seat.
tutorials.mb_flippyCard_desc: Cards dealt will show at the center of the screen. You can click and hold each card to squeeze or click to open all cards at once.
tutorials.mb_cardDisplay_desc: This displays the card values being dealt and scanned.  In Flippy Baccarat, the display includes a squeeze feature to slowly peek the cards.
